annotations.title: Assess HK Corporate Bank Account Eligibility

description: Assess corporate bank account opening eligibility, official bank tariff schedules (Tariff Guide), and tailored statutory KYC document checklists for HSBC Hong Kong (official API integration) and OCBC Bank Hong Kong (official brand authorization, 100% opening fee waived for eligible HC Business clients). Unlogged-in users (without api_key) are subject to the 3 free queries/day per IP limit; logged-in users with a free API key from https://www.86hc.com/user enjoy 20 free queries/day. Pass a Hong Kong company name, CR No., or 8-digit BRN to automatically check its statutory status, incorporation age (<1yr startup vs >=1yr established), and required filings (NNC1 vs NAR1).

api_key.description: Optional 86hc.com MCP API key (format: hkq_live_xxxx). Omit or leave empty to use the automatic Guest IP Trial Mode (3 free company detail queries/day + direct Stripe filing orders without a key). Free API key with 20 daily company queries available at https://www.86hc.com/user

bank_target.description: Target bank to evaluate: hsbc (HSBC Hong Kong), ocbc (OCBC Bank Hong Kong), or both.

has_mainland_entity.description: Whether the directors/shareholders have an affiliated Mainland China or overseas operating company.

identifier.description: Optional Hong Kong company name (Chinese/English), 7-digit CR No., or 8-digit BRN to automatically verify from the 3.9M+ corporate registry.

industry.description: Business industry code or description (e.g. EXPORT_TRADE, ECOMMERCE_2C, ECOMMERCE_2B, IT_SOFTWARE, CONSULTING_SVC, STARTUP_COMPANY, LOGISTICS_SUPPLY).

name: assess_bank_account_eligibility
